title: Linear bound conjecture for r-wise fractional L-intersecting families
statement:
Let $cmathcal{F}$ be an $r$-wise fractional $L$-intersecting family, where $L=\{a/b\}$. The family is **r-wise fractional L-intersecting** if every $r$ distinct members have pairwise fractional intersections in $L$. **Linear bound conjecture.** Then

$$
|\mathcal{F}| = \mathcal{O}\left((r-1)n \right).
$$

The paper currently proves an upper bound of order $\mathcal{O}\left((r-1)n\frac{\ln^2 n}{\ln\ln n}\right)$ in the singleton case; the conjectured linear bound remains open.
source_name: Tapas Kumar Mishra, “r-wise fractional L-intersecting family”, arXiv:1909.13217 (2021).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.13217

Status: **open** according to the source (as of September 2019). “We believe that in this case, $|\mathcal{F}| \in \Theta(n^s)$ and improving the bound in Theorem remains open.”
